datasets.name: UIUC Course Catalog
datasets.origin: University of Illinois Course Explorer API (courses.illinois.edu)
datasets.used_for: courses, credit hours, prerequisites, terms offered, Fall 2026 / Spring 2027 offerings

datasets.name: UIUC GPA Dataset
datasets.origin: Grade distributions released by the University of Illinois (FOIA / Senate EP.25.072)
datasets.used_for: pass rates, average GPA, withdrawal rates, typical class size (2021-2026)

datasets.name: FiveThirtyEight College Majors
datasets.origin: US Census American Community Survey 2010-2012 PUMS
datasets.used_for: career outcomes: median salary, unemployment, college-level job share by major

notes: Degree rules are modelled on the UIUC CS B.S. curriculum (simplified). Demo students are fictional. Live seat changes in the registrar feed are simulated around each course's real typical enrolment.
